sub_indicators.label: National broadband plan
sub_indicators.subject: gov.policy
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Broadband Commission's first target is a funded national broadband plan in every country by 2025. The African Union's Digital Transformation Strategy sets the 2030 outcome: universal access at 6 Mb/s or more, at no more than one US cent a megabyte.
criteria: A source from the past three years says the country has no national broadband plan and none is being written.
A national broadband plan is being written or is out for consultation, or the last one has ended with no successor adopted.

A national broadband plan is adopted by the government or the minister and its period has not ended. It may be part of a larger digital strategy or development plan that states broadband targets. No money tied to it is on record in the past three years.
Money has been committed to the plan in the past three years: a budget line, a universal service fund allocation or a financed programme that the source ties to the plan.
The plan is funded, and the government has published figures against the plan's own targets in the past three years. Whether the targets are met is not judged.
